picker

Picker that pops up from the bottom.

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
header-text String No Picker title, which is available only for Android.
cancel-text String No Text of the cancel button of the selector (Minimum version: 24.12. 0)
confirm-text String No Confirm button text of the selector (Minimum version: 24.12. 0)
mode String selector No Picker type.
disabled Boolean false No Disabled or not.
bindcancel eventHandle No Triggered when the pick is canceled.

Valid Values of mode

Value Description
selector Common picker.
multiSelector Multi-column picker.
time Time picker.
date Date picker.
region Region picker.

In addition to the preceding common attributes, picker has different attributes for different modes.

Common picker: mode = selector

Attribute Type Default Value Description
range Array/Object array [] It is valid when mode is set to selector or multiSelector.
range-key String Specifies the value of key in the object as the picker display content when range is an object array.
value Number 0 Sequence number of the selected range (the subscript starts from 0).
bindchange eventHandle The change event triggered when value changes. The output is event.detail = {value}.

Multi-column picker: mode = multiSelector

Attribute Type Default Value Description
range Array/Object array [] It is valid when mode is set to selector or multiSelector.
range-key String Specifies the value of key in the object as the picker display content when range is an object array.
value Array [] Sequence number of the selected range (the subscript starts from 0).
bindchange eventHandle The change event triggered when value changes. The output is event.detail = {value}.
bindcolumnchange eventHandle Triggered when the column changes.

Time picker: mode = time

Attribute Type Default Value Description
value String Selected time, in the format of hh:mm.
start String Start time of a valid time range, in the format of hh:mm.
end String End time of a valid time range, in the format of hh:mm.
bindchange eventHandle The change event triggered when value changes. The output is event.detail = {value}.

Date picker: mode = date

Attribute Type Default Value Description
value String If the current day is within the valid range, the current day is displayed. Otherwise, the end date of the valid range is displayed. Selected date, in the format of YYYY-MM-DD.
start String Start date of a valid date range, in the format of YYYY-MM-DD.
end String End date of a valid date range, in the format of YYYY-MM-DD.
fields String day Granularity of the picker. The options are as follows: year, month, and day.
bindchange eventHandle The change event triggered when value changes. The output is event.detail = {value}.

Valid Values of fields

Value Description
year Picker granularity is year.
month Picker granularity is month.
day Picker granularity is day.

Region picker: mode = region

Attribute Type Default Value Description
value Array [] Selected region. By default, the first value in each column is selected.
custom-item String Customize an entry to the top of each column.
bindchange eventHandle Triggers the change event when value changes. The output is event.detail = {value, code}. The code field is the zoning code for statistics.

Sample Code


<view>
  <picker name='picker1' headerText='title' bindchange='bindPickerChange' bindcancel='bindcancel' value='{{index}}'
          range='{{array}}'>
    <view>{{array[index]}}</view>
  </picker>
</view>

Page({
  data: {
    array: ['USA', 'China', 'Brazil', 'Japan'],
    index: 0,
  },
  bindPickerChange: function(e) {
    console.log(e.detail.value)
    this.setData({
      index: e.detail.value
    })
  },
  bindcancel: function(e) {
    console.log(e)
  },
})
